Now he climbed the spiral stairs, copied the coordinates from the note into the log, and decided that tonight, for the first time in his life, he would radio the mainland himself.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一头沉睡的巨兽。街灯还亮着，在湿漉漉的柏油路上投下昏黄的光晕。环卫工人推着车缓缓走过，扫帚划过地面的声音格外清晰。远处的高楼只剩零星几扇窗透出微光，像夜色里未闭的眼睛。二十四小时便利店的招牌孤零零地闪烁，玻璃门内，店员趴在柜台上打盹。一只流浪猫贴着墙根溜过，警惕地环顾四周。空气里混着露水与尘土的气息。第一班公交车发出低沉的轰鸣驶过街口——新的一天，正从黑暗中悄悄醒来。", "w03": "• Imagine standing between two mirrors that face each other: each reflection contains a smaller reflection, which contains another, until somewhere deep down there's just you.\n• Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by doing one small piece of work and then handing the rest of the job to a copy of itself, which does the same thing.\n• Every recursive function needs a 'base case'—a smallest problem it can answer directly without calling itself—otherwise the reflections would go on forever and never finish!"}
